lines.3: Crab pinched the hem of my shirt between her fingers and tugged it from side to side.
lines.6: 「I wouldn't go as far as stifling.」
lines.7: 「Well, if it ever gets too hard, you can sleep in my room.」
lines.8: 「Did you eat something weird? That's awfully nice of you.」
lines.9: 「The lodging fee is 2,000 yen a night.」
lines.10: 「...So that's all you wanted, huh? Tch!」
lines.11: 「Summer's almost here. I expect to have a lot of expenses.」
lines.12: 「Don't go selling your panties to some shady shop.」
lines.13: 「I won't! How rude! I don't like jokes like that. I'm the innocent type.」
lines.14: 「The innocent type doesn't try to charge a guy 2,000 yen to sleep in her room.」
lines.15: 「You're the only guy I'd ever let stay in my room!」
lines.16: 「...Didn't you just say something pretty outrageous like it was nothing?」
lines.17: 「Don't get the wrong idea! It's only because I don't have to be considerate around you!」
lines.18: 「Well, I won't need to impose on you anyway.」
lines.19: 「I'm managing somehow, even with her nagging me all the time.」
